title: fix(mcp): name notRecorded in the record tools descriptions; never name __search as not recorded
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8YQgdqmVpPyn5tDL2dx5FM5)_

Part of #35429 (items 1 and 3; item 2, the ask-card question, is split to #37473)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- AI 助手查数据被拒时，能提前知道"未记录"的含义，不会把没记录的数据说成 0 或空；用户无直接界面变化。
- 属于问数准确性的收尾工作，替所有用 AI 问数的用户解决误报空值的问题。
- 出错只会让 AI 的说明文字不准，不影响数据，可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。第二项（新增一个"未记录"问题）已拆到 #37473 单独处理。

## What changes
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`: one shared `NOT_RECORDED_DESCRIPTION` sentence beside `OBJECT_QUERY_SOURCE_DESCRIPTION`, used by the `query_records`, `aggregate_records` and `get_record` descriptions (item 1). `get_record` sends no field names, so its `notRecorded` only ever names an object; the sentence says "what it names", true for both.
- `whereFieldNames` skips `SEARCH_COMPANION_FIELD` (already imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`), so a where or aggregation filter refused for another reason never names `__search` (item 3).
- One patch changeset.

## Tests
New top-level describe in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-not-recorded.test.ts` (the shared harness, per AGENTS.md): the three registered descriptions name `notRecorded` / `ifNotRecorded`; `__search` at top level, under `$or` and in an aggregation filter is never named; a where whose only unshown key is `__search` carries no member. Ablation: with the source file restored to 5d21d431 the five new tests fail (5 failed / 22 passed); restored, 27/27.
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: 85 files / 1526 tests passed; `typecheck` exit 0 (head cf2ba9b6, after merging main a46efa8c; ablation re-run there: 5 failed / 22 passed, then 27/27).

## Acceptance notes
- Item 2 (one not-recorded ask question) is split to #37473: it widens the dataset-card question band, outside this card's file surface. This PR stays Part of #35429.
- Assumption A holds: neither `september_commission` nor `recoverable_vat` is described as the not-recorded question.

## Verification
Read first: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (`whereFieldNames` and `NOT_RECORDED_DESCRIPTION`).
Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-not-recorded.test.ts`, expect 27 passed.
